title: Jump Game
summary: Decide whether you can reach the last index when each value is the longest jump from that index. Track the farthest reachable index; if you ever stand beyond it, you are stuck.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Jump lengths
inputs.note: Whole numbers from 0 to 9: the longest jump allowed from each index.

anchors.label: Beyond the reach: the end is unreachable
